source_caption: I’m Gonna Git You Sucka (1988) is a parody comedy that spoofs classic blaxploitation films of the 1970s. Starring Keenen Ivory Wayans, the film follows Jack Spade, a man who returns to his neighborhood after his brother’s death and takes on a crime syndicate responsible for selling overpriced gold chains. Packed with absurd humor, exaggerated characters, and satire, the movie became a cult favorite for its over-the-top take on action and street culture clichés.

source_details.synopsis: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka is a 1988 American blaxploitation parody film written, directed by and starring Keenen Ivory Wayans in his directorial debut. Featured in the film are several noteworthy African-American actors who were part of the genre of blaxploitation: Jim Brown, Bernie Casey, Antonio Fargas and Isaac Hayes. It co-stars John Vernon, Kadeem Hardison, Ja'net Dubois, John Witherspoon, Damon Wayans, Clarence Williams III, Dawnn Lewis, and Chris Rock, and acts as the film debuts of comedian Robin Harris and brothers Shawn and Marlon Wayans.
